title: Divergence identity: (ℓ∘L)∧λ_0∧⋯λ̂_j⋯∧λ_m = (−1)^j ℓ(e_j)·λ_0∧⋯∧λ_m
statement:
Let P, m ∈ ℕ, let L : ℝ^P → ℝ^{m+1} be a continuous linear map, let ℓ : ℝ^{m+1} → ℝ be a continuous linear functional, and let j ∈ Fin (m+1). For i ∈ Fin (m+1) let λ_i := y^i∘L, where y^i = EuclideanSpace.proj i is the i-th coordinate function, and let e_j := EuclideanSpace.single j 1. Then
wedgeCovectors (m+1) (Fin.cons (ℓ∘L) (λ∘j.succAbove)) = ((−1)^j·ℓ(e_j)) • wedgeCovectors (m+1) λ,
that is, (ℓ∘L)∧λ_0∧⋯∧λ̂_j∧⋯∧λ_m = (−1)^j ℓ(e_j)·λ_0∧⋯∧λ_m.
lean_statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (L : Eucl P →L[ℝ] Eucl (m + 1)) (ℓ : Eucl (m + 1) →L[ℝ] ℝ) (j : Fin (m + 1)), wedgeCovectors (m + 1) (Fin.cons (ℓ.comp L) (fun i => (EuclideanSpace.proj (j.succAbove i) : Eucl (m + 1) →L[ℝ] ℝ).comp L) : Fin (m + 1) → (Eucl P →L[ℝ] ℝ)) = ((-1 : ℝ) ^ (j : ℕ) * ℓ (EuclideanSpace.single j (1 : ℝ))) • wedgeCovectors (m + 1) (fun i => (EuclideanSpace.proj i : Eucl (m + 1) →L[ℝ] ℝ).comp L)
